verdicts.title: The relative class number one problem for function fields, I
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We reduce the classification of finite extensions of function fields (of curves over finite fields) with the same class number to a finite computation; complete this computation in all cases except when both curves have base field $\mathbb{F}_2$ and genus $>1$; and give a conjectural answer in the remaining cases. The conjecture will be resolved in subsequent papers.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns classifying finite extensions of function fields with equal class number, with no mention of 3-SAT, resolution proof length, or quadratic number fields Q(√m); it shares only the 'class number' vocabulary.

verdicts.title: An exact algorithm for 1-in-3 SAT
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: 1-in-3 SAT is an NP-complete variant of 3-SAT\ where a "clause" is satisfied iff exactly one of its three literal is satisfied. We present here an exact algorithm solving \oit\ in time $O^*(1.260^n)$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes an exact exponential-time algorithm for 1-in-3 SAT, with no mention of class numbers, number fields, or resolution proof length, so it does not interact with the specific claim.
